name: Jalgaon
registryBasis: The Maharashtra Land Records Department’s Jalgaon district information page identifies the district land-records administration and subordinate offices, including the local city-survey function. The Jalgaon municipal corporation separately publishes municipal services. This supports a local land-record registry function, but no anonymous full-parcel geometry route was verified.
pointBasis: UN WUP 2025 population-weighted settlement centroid; this is not a municipal boundary or a parcel-coverage claim.
technicalBlocker: No anonymous full-parcel geometry endpoint or geometry-only schema was verified. The municipal property-tax route requests property identifiers and personal details, so it was not used.
scopeLimits: Official district land-records metadata and municipal portal only. No property number, owner, phone, Aadhaar, tax balance, or personal-data query was made. The official district page advertises a Bhunakasha map-download portal, but its homepage timed out; no plot selection or record query was made.
remainingUncertainty: A public cadastral map may exist in a separate survey system, but no safe schema-first route was verified.

officialSources.observation: Official Maharashtra Land Records page for Jalgaon district identifies district and subordinate land-records offices, including the Jalgaon local survey remit.
Official Jalgaon City Municipal Corporation portal; municipal service presence is contextual only and no property-tax search was used.

The official Jalgaon district land-records page links this portal for land-map downloads. A bounded anonymous HTTPS GET to the portal homepage timed out with curl status 000 and zero bytes; no geometry/schema or data response was obtained.
